SELECT DISTINCT gs.XCL_006
FROM gasstations AS gs
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    JOIN customers AS c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    JOIN products AS p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
    WHERE t.XCL_015 = gs.XCL_004
      AND c.XCL_002 = 'LAM'
      AND c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
) AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM transactions_1k AS t2
    WHERE t2.XCL_015 = gs.XCL_004
      AND t2.XCL_011 >= '2013-06-01'
      AND t2.XCL_011 < '2013-07-01'
)

SELECT DISTINCT gs.XCL_006
FROM gasstations AS gs
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    JOIN customers AS c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE t.XCL_015 = gs.XCL_004
      AND c.XCL_002 = 'LAM'
      AND c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
) AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM transactions_1k AS t2
    WHERE t2.XCL_015 = gs.XCL_004
      AND t2.XCL_011 >= '2013-06-01'
      AND t2.XCL_011 < '2013-07-01'
)
